title: EssentialsNext
description: A simple and lightweight Essentials alternative for Paper servers with homes, kits, teleport requests and AFK system.
body:
# ⭐ EssentialsNext

**EssentialsNext** is a next‑generation Essentials plugin designed for modern Minecraft servers that demand performance, flexibility, and professional‑level customization. Built from the ground up with clean architecture and real server experience, EssentialsNext delivers all the classic utilities you expect—without the lag, clutter, or outdated systems of older Essentials plugins.

Whether you run a survival server, PvP network, SMP, minigame hub, or large‑scale community, EssentialsNext provides powerful core utilities while staying lightweight, modular, and fully configurable.

---

# 🚀 Why EssentialsNext?

Most Essentials plugins were created years ago and became bloated, slow, or difficult to customize. EssentialsNext was built with a different philosophy:

• **Performance first** – optimized systems and async‑safe saving
• **Modular design** – enable only what you need
• **Modern codebase** – clean structure, easy to maintain
• **Full customization** – configs, GUIs, messages, permissions
• **Network‑ready** – works for both small SMPs and big servers
• **Multi‑language support** – easy translations
• **LuckPerms integration** – advanced permission control

EssentialsNext is not just another Essentials clone—it’s an upgrade for modern servers.

---

# 🧩 Features

## 🏠 Homes System

• Per‑player home files stored in organized folders
• Configurable teleport delay
• LuckPerms‑based home limits (essentialsnext.homes.X)
• Home list GUI or chat list
• Teleport cancel on movement
• Multi‑world safe homes

## 🌍 Warps System

• Admin‑created server warps
• Warp permission control
• Warp categories
• Safe teleport with delay

## 📍 Spawn System

• Global spawn with delay option
• Teleport on first join
• Multi‑world spawn support
• Spawn permission control

## 🤝 TPA System

• Player teleport requests
• Self‑TPA detection
• Timeout and cooldown system
• Accept / deny commands
• Customizable messages

## 💤 Smart AFK System

• Automatic AFK detection
• Detects ALL player interactions
• AFK prefix in TAB list
• Configurable AFK timer
• Remove AFK on move, chat, click, etc.

## 🛠️ Utility Commands

• Gamemode shortcuts
• Heal / Feed / Fly aliases
• Reload command
• Future‑ready admin tools

---

# 🌍 Multi‑Language Support

EssentialsNext supports multiple languages with easy configuration.

Supported languages:
• English
• Spanish
• Portuguese
• And more with custom lang files

Every message uses MiniMessage format, so you can use gradients, colors, and formatting easily.

---

# ⚙️ Fully Customizable

Everything in EssentialsNext can be configured:

• Config.yml modules
• Messages
• Prefix
• Teleport delays
• AFK behavior
• Permissions

You control how your server works.

---

# 📂 Clean Architecture

EssentialsNext is organized for developers and server owners:

commands/ → command logic
managers/ → system logic and saving
listeners/ → event handling
config/ → language and config system

This makes it easy to modify, expand, or create addons.

---

# 🔐 Permissions Ready

Works perfectly with LuckPerms.

Examples:
• essentialsnext.homes.5 → 5 homes
• essentialsnext.kit.vip → VIP kit
• essentialsnext.warp.admin → admin warps
• essentialsnext.tpa.bypass → bypass cooldown

---

# ⚡ Performance Focused

• Async saving for player data
• Lightweight config loading
• Optimized teleport system
• Minimal memory usage
• No unnecessary listeners

Perfect for large servers and networks.

---

# 🧠 Future Roadmap

• Economy integration
• Player mail system
• Advanced GUI editor
• Web panel
• Database support
• API for other plugins
• Network sync

EssentialsNext is designed to grow with your server.
